notes.title: Where are we at today?
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

We appreciate all of the patience and excitement everyone has for [b]The Economic West[/b]! We are in the final stretch of testing all of the multiplayer functionality, then we will be prepped for release!

We cannot wait for you to jump into The Economic West, and we hope to even meet and play with you all!

We do not anticipate the testing to be much longer, hopefully within a week or so. Please make sure you are subscribed for updates as we will send a push once the game is ready to go live!

See you in the [i]West[/i] soon,
-unknownfriends
